mechanism: Reducing the size of information while preserving the meaning that matters to its consumer. Which meaning matters is the caller's to state; whether the reduction can be undone is the compressor's to declare. No coder shrinks every input.
invariants: States whether exact reconstruction of its input is available.
Where reconstruction is declared available, Inverse(Output) == Input bit-for-bit.
A compressor that cannot reduce an input reports that rather than emitting an expanded output as compressed.
